the_ferry.name: The Ferry
the_ferry.goal: Recapture the heart and finish the coronation; failing that, make a new Raft

steps.text: The fallen Lure Temple's last light reaches the Ferry: something broke it in Incheon. Wujing is sent back.
steps.trace: At dawn a quiet man in a grey coat is fishing off the Wolmi seawall, nine dark beads at his throat

then.text: Wujing walks Michuhol-gu and searches the padlocked dojang a second time
then.trace: The dojang padlock has been oiled, and there is a wet footprint in the courtyard ring
then.stops_if: Mori is training there when he comes (the pendant goes ice-cold)

asgard.name: Asgard
asgard.goal: Find the one being fate cannot weave, and have him lead the fight against the End

steps.text: Ha Sion's memory of the 0.0 reading and the iron ring goes to Asgard by raven
steps.trace: Crows line the St. Mary's roof; one follows Mori home

then.text: Ha Sion pulls the 2041 street-fight video and the Jin family's Gate records
then.trace: His sister finds a KAB terminal's login in the ward's access log

steps.text: Gwon Taesan reads the W-117 file and has the site sealed pending 'structural survey'
steps.trace: KAB trucks and tape at Wolmi; W-117's yellow tag is gone a day early

steps.text: Pyo sells the story of a lucky brass ring and a gold Gate to a broker
steps.trace: A stranger at Sinpo Market is asking about a porter with a brass ring

steps.text: Boss Gu marks the E-rank who walked out of a sealed room as useful
steps.trace: Gangu passes it on, unhappy: Boss Gu wants to meet

steps.text: A third consent packet goes under the Jin flat's door, and a Society visitor sits an hour at Choi Sunhee's bed
steps.trace: The night nurse mentions a polite visitor who hummed along with the patient

then.text: Three new sleepers are admitted to the fourth floor, each stamped SW -0.8
then.trace: Three more beds on the ward; one is somebody's mother from the market

steps.text: The Heaven's Cup announces Incheon qualifiers
steps.trace: Cup posters on every bus shelter; Daeil signs them both up as a joke

steps.text: Yeon Hayul clears a green Gate in Songdo alone, on stream
steps.trace: The clip is on every phone on the ward; Jung has watched it eleven times

steps.text: The Register's date for the body named Jin Mori arrives (14 March 2048)
